stories.title: Lock Expiration and Recovery Logic
stories.description: Implement TTL expiration enforcement and recovery flow allowing a new owner to safely acquire an expired lock. Include conflict handling when stale owners attempt renewal after expiry.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Lock TTL and Ownership Enforcement
stories.description: Create unit tests validating TTL expiration, ownership validation, renewal rejection for non-owners, and correct recovery behavior after expiration.

stories.title: Integration Tests for Concurrent Lock Contention
stories.description: Simulate concurrent Brain runner instances competing for the same lock to validate single-writer enforcement, TTL expiry takeover, and absence of race conditions.

stories.title: Fail-Safe Lock Release on Process Termination
stories.description: Ensure locks are safely released or allowed to expire when a Brain runner process crashes or exits unexpectedly. Validate no permanent deadlocks occur.
